description:
I thought I would be born a beta male and live an ordinary life until I suddenly manifested as an omega. After living my life that changed completely overnight, I gave up judo, which was so precious to me, and became the exclusive bodyguard for an omega family. Even so, I thought I would live quietly like this and die. Until I got into an accident with my employer’s son. No, until I realized that I got pregnant because of that one incident.

 *“Is there anyone else besides us who knows this?”*

Before I could even accept the fact that I was pregnant, the person proposed to me as calmly as if offering me a glass of water. 

 *“Mr. Ho Jun-Kyung, will you marry me?”*

The problem is that the person proposing is not the child’s biological father, but his older brother. Jun-Kyung’s life, which had been ordinary, becomes a drama overnight when it becomes entangled with him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
